The operation or the project would entail regular cycles of pumping and generation and would interchange up to 30,228 acre-feet of water between the upper and lower recervoirs. Segments of the fish populations in the reservoirs could be attracted to the powerhouse intake structure and drawn through the pump-turbine units. Some fish would be unavoidably lost during the operation of the project, but the extent of such mortality or the particular species involved is not known.
5.3.2 Air and Noise Quality
During project construction, some increases in air pollutants and noise would be created from dust, smoke, operation of construction equipment, and blasting. These impacts would be short-term and limited to the period of construction.
5.3.3 Recreation
Development of the proposed hiking trail would result in some soil movement into streams. However, the Applicant intends to minimize soil erosion and its adverse effects on water quality through sloping, planting the banks of graded areas, and construction of drainage structures.
